_comment: Baked by scripts/bake_updates.py from hebrish.app/changelog; do not edit by hand. Shown offline in the apps' What's new (Android Updates screen, desktop About tab).

entries.title: Ubuntu 1.031: Settings in their own window, Transcription as a Notepad
entries.summary: The main window holds the modes: Voice Typing, Transcription and History. Settings, Models, Dictionary, Updates, Diagnostics and About open in a separate Settings window, from the buttons at the top or Settings… in the tray menu.

entries.title: Ubuntu 1.030: Enter waits for the last words
entries.summary: Send pressed early: Hold the send key until they're in now also covers an Enter pressed while you're still recording (with The send key stops recording on).

entries.title: Falafel: the third model in active development
entries.summary: Falafel, the voice-command model, has its own page and sits beside Sabich and Shakshuka on /models and the home page. Two sizes, Falafel (desktop) and Falafel 110M (phones and laptop CPUs).

entries.title: Ubuntu 1.029: late words stay on the clipboard
entries.summary: Late words: when Enter goes in before the last words, Ctrl+V now pastes just the words that were missed. With "whole take on the clipboard" on, the whole take used to replace them a moment later.

entries.title: Ubuntu 1.028: Falafel coming soon
entries.summary: Falafel: the new model for short voice commands has its own tab under Models, in a full size and a small one. It shows Coming soon until its first version is out, then downloads like any other model, with no app update.

entries.title: Ubuntu 1.027: same version as Android
entries.summary: No changes: same app as 1.026, with the version number kept in step with Android. Windows and the AppImage stay on 1.026.

entries.title: Apps 1.026: a joint stable release, with a smoother look
entries.summary: One version everywhere: Android, Ubuntu and Windows are all 1.026. Windows and the AppImage move up from 1.022.

entries.title: Stickers to download and print
entries.summary: Stickers, under About: the logo in English and Hebrew, Corn the Sloth, and "I type with Hebrish", as print-ready PDFs and transparent PNGs.

entries.title: The home page opens with the comparison, and a shorter footer
entries.summary: The first thing on the home page is now regular speech recognition typing a sentence and getting the Hebrew wrong, then Hebrish typing it, then the headline benchmark numbers.

entries.title: Home page second pass, and a dataset index
entries.summary: The home page leads with what Hebrish is, and regular speech recognition and Hebrish are side by side at the top again.

entries.title: Just Sabich, and quicker Android downloads
entries.summary: The home page now says Sabich, with no version number. The model page shows the version in the apps, read live, and the latest benchmarked release.

entries.title: Benchmarks, to see how Hebrish runs on your computer
entries.summary: Benchmarks: a new window, opened from Diagnostics, measures how fast Hebrish transcribes and how much memory and CPU it uses.

entries.title: Calibrate the noise filter for your mic and room
entries.summary: Noise filter: a 0 to 100 dial on the Voice Typing tab, set a little stricter than before, to keep room noise from turning into stray words.

entries.title: Home page reordered, and Support the project moves under About
entries.summary: The home page now offers the apps before asking for help, and a new section links to the use cases, manual, screenshots, models, blog and roadmap.

entries.title: Daniel's story, a new support page, and breadcrumbs on model pages
entries.summary: About now opens with who makes Hebrish and why, with a real photo and some dictation facts.

entries.title: The training blend, and category charts
entries.summary: /models now explains the training blend: the five ingredients, what each one is for, and why LibriSpeech is in the mix, with Corn at the blender.

entries.title: Windows catches up
entries.summary: Windows and AppImage: a new stable build with everything since Windows 1.012.

entries.title: Paste last only pastes what was missed, and Corn on the start-up screen
entries.summary: Paste last: after an early Enter kept your last words out of a message, the Paste last key and tray item now paste only those words, not the whole take again.

entries.title: Licensing in the top menu, a clearer models page, and Corn
entries.summary: Licensing is now in the top menu and opens with what each part of Hebrish is licensed under, with the Creative Commons icons.

entries.title: See what each Sabich and Shakshuka version was trained on
entries.summary: /models now leads with the two models in active development, Sabich and Shakshuka, with a training explorer: hours of audio at each version, then clips, speakers, the blend and topics for any version you pick.
